name: revenue_by_year
description: Total invoice revenue for every year in the sales database.

description: Top countries by invoice revenue, optionally for one year.

name: top_genres_by_tracks_sold
description: Genres ranked by number of tracks sold.

name: send_report
description: Send a report to a recipient. This is an external side effect and always needs a human to approve it.
